name: cs-routedesk-gateway
description: Public entrypoint for RouteDesk. Reverse-proxies to internal-routing backend apps in the same Private Space.

TICKET_SERVICE_HOST.description: Hostname of the cs-routedesk-ticket-service app. Private Space apps get a randomized hostname (not <appname>.herokuapp.com) - get it via 'heroku apps:info -a cs-routedesk-ticket-service'.
